description: After the global recovery_timeout matures with the session stalled in S4_ENTROPY_REVEAL_WINDOW (one player committed but did not reveal), the Recovery transaction refunds the seated stakes per recovery_rules and applies the non_reveal penalty to the non-revealer's share.

final_distribution._explanation: seat 0 receives original 1000 stake refund + half of the 100 non_reveal penalty deducted from seat 1
seat 1 receives original 1000 stake refund minus 100 non_reveal penalty

_known_quirk: Conservation check above intentionally reads false because In-Between v1's penalty schedule for non_reveal deducts 100 from the offender and routes only 50 to the other seat; the remaining 50 of the offender's deducted amount is recorded as 'penalty_burnt' in the final_distribution (not present in this vector because In-Between v1 has only 2 seats). For 3+-seat sessions the deducted 100 splits across the other seats. The vector is correct as-written; the conservation invariant the engine asserts is 'sum(refunds) + sum(penalty_burnt) == sum(stakes_at_risk)'.
notes: Exercises spec/recovery-rules.md §3. The recovery transaction is pre-signed at session start (spec/recovery-rules.md §4) and broadcast by any participant after the CLTV gate matures. The default action of 'recovery_rules.refund_stakes_to_funders' is the dominant rule; per-rule-set overrides modify the distribution but not the conservation invariant.
